name: Abakainon
description:
Exploitation of their rich wooded valley is hampered by Longane unfriendliness. A Sikel hill town, oligarch-led and only somewhat touched by Greek ways, gated on its 600 m hilltop for defence. Its valley gives timber and pork, worked at only modest intensity, and its surplus goes out to Longane, Goraion and Tissa. Longane counts it a rival and holds soft sway over it alongside Goraion. Reconstructed from the 2019 sheet; the name and the site are both probable; nothing further is attested for 492 BC.
